summary: Auto-generated format support matrix from the live adapter registry, grouped by canonical content kind, in the kind hub's order and names, with adapter id, output extensions, and human label. It documents CLI listing, inspection, conversion, and validation, with SillyTavern CCv3 as the default portable character shape for thin hosts. The current registry has nine character, seven lorebook, four persona, one pack, four preset, one Script Sheet, five regex-set, one quick-reply and one prompt-format adapter. The pack adapter, image-pack, writes a zip of pictures and sounds. Tools (kind tool), dice (kind dice), formulas (kind formula), trackers (kind tracker), skills (kind skill) and drawings (kind htmldoc) have no import or export format yet, and their sections say so. Notes explain content-sniff detection, fixture-proven same-format round trips, honest cross-format loss reporting, and sample locations. Because the page is generated, counts and rows change only with the registry.

sections.title: How to use
sections.summary: Documents the primary CLI entry points for format work: bun run bunzai formats to list adapters, bunzai inspect on a card path, bunzai convert with --to for a target such as sillytavern, and bunzai validate on card JSON. The default portable character shape for thin hosts including C.AI Tools dumps and Crushon import is SillyTavern CCv3 through the sillytavern adapter.

sections.title: Characters (9)
sections.summary: Nine character adapters. agnai writes .json for Agnai Agnaistic. backyard writes .json for Backyard.ai or Faraday legacy json. byaf writes .byaf Backyard archives. lumiverse writes .json and .charx for ST plus modules. pygmalion writes .json and .png flat character. risu writes .charx zip with card.json and assets. rolecall writes .json for RoleCall v3 png or json cards. sillytavern writes .json for SillyTavern CCv2 and v3 png or json. vaud-json writes .json as Bunzai native. All are kind character.

sections.title: Lorebooks (7)
sections.summary: Seven lorebook adapters. agnai-lorebook writes .json Agnai memory books. marinara-lorebook writes .json native .marinara.json export. novelai-lorebook writes .lorebook for NovelAI native export or json. risu-lorebook writes .json RisuAI native export. rolecall-lorebook writes .json RoleCall v1 export. rolecall-compendium writes .json RoleCall compendium export. sillytavern-lorebook writes .json SillyTavern world info worldbook. All are kind lorebook.

sections.title: Personas (4)
sections.summary: Four persona adapters, all writing .json. lumiverse-persona is a Lumiverse account object. marinara-persona carries theming and stat bars sealed. rolecall-persona is rcpersona or RC persona-card export. sillytavern-persona is a SillyTavern personas backup where the default persona is primary and the rest ride sealed.

sections.title: Notes
sections.summary: Detection is content-sniff, not only extension; prefer bunzai label when unsure. Same-format round-trips aim for lossless where fixtures prove it, see adapter tests and samples/. Cross-format convert keeps what the target can express; use export honesty in the studio UI for drop notes. Dropped or skipped host-native bags such as Character.AI and Crushon should use Default CCv3 via the sillytavern adapter.

sections.title: Samples
sections.summary: Lists sample fixture folders under samples/. sillytavern holds CCv2/v3 and Seraphina.png. rolecall has RC character plus lorebook. risu has .charx and card json. agnai, backyard .byaf, pygmalion classic flat, lumiverse ST plus Lumi extensions, chub ST plus extensions.chub, marinara lorebook envelope plus prompt preset, and novelai lorebook complete the corpus map.
